page.pausedBody: This campaign is {status} (<raw>{code}</raw>). Annotators only pick up work while the campaign is running. Ask the campaign manager when it’s expected to resume.
page.queueReadFailed: The queue could not be read. Reload the page to try again.
page.sampleFailedTitle: The image for this task could not be loaded
page.sampleFailedBody: Reload the page to try again. If it still does not load, skip the task: it goes back to the queue and you get another one.
page.imageAlt: Image to read at the {step} step
page.seriesLabel: Series to read at the {step} step
page.startPrompt: Press Start to take the next task at the {step} step. Nothing is reserved for you until you do.
page.afterSkipped: Task skipped. It goes back to the queue for someone else.
page.afterClosed: This task no longer needs your answer: someone else settled it first, or it was given back after the time limit. Your answer was not saved.

form.annotationHint: Free-form JSON today (e.g. {example} for classification, or a mask URL for segmentation). The tool-integration-aware schema lands with #214.
form.acknowledge: I have read the current instructions, version <mono>{version}</mono>.
form.waitingForSample: Submit is available once the image is on screen.
form.skipHint: Skip gives this task back unread, so another annotator can take it.

labels.reasonHint: Required. Why this is the final label; stored and exported with it.

viewer.help: When zoomed, drag the image or focus it and use the arrow keys to move around.
viewer.region: Image (focus to pan with the arrow keys)
viewer.failed: The image could not be loaded. Its address may have expired: reload the page to get a new one.

actions.needRole: You need an annotation role (annotator / arbitration-annotator / expert-reviewer).
actions.needRoleToSubmit: You need an annotation role to submit.
actions.needRoleToSkip: You need an annotation role to skip a task.
actions.nothingWaiting: No tasks are waiting for you right now. New ones appear when the campaign manager adds them or when an earlier step finishes.
actions.giveReason: Give the reason for the final label.
actions.notJsonObject: Submission must be a JSON object.
actions.notOnScreen: The image is not on screen yet. Wait until it is drawn, then submit. Your answer was kept.
actions.instructionsChanged: The instructions have changed (now version {version}). Read the current instructions and confirm them before submitting. Your annotation was kept.
actions.notAccepted: The answer does not match what the campaign accepts. Check the answer and the reason, then submit again.
actions.startForbidden: Your account cannot take tasks in this campaign.
actions.campaignNotRunning: The campaign is not running, so it hands out no tasks. Reload the page.
actions.notYourTask: This task cannot be answered from your account. Your answer was not saved.
actions.taskNotFound: This task no longer exists. Start the next task.
actions.skipForbidden: This task cannot be skipped from your account.
actions.serverError: Something went wrong on the server (error {status}). Try again, or reload the page.
